Vikram’s friend informs Dolly that Popatlal has gone missing from his room. Dolly finds Nitin and Popatlal in a washroom. Nitin asks one of his friends as to why he didn’t give him the key of his room.
If you are trying to view this video from a location outside India, do note this video will be made available in your territory 48 hours after its upload time
